title: Milk Bought on Its Own in the Keep of a Giving School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
The keep of a sibling netting between School Nutrition Services Meal Accounts counts milk bought on its own by how many times it was rung up on the account in the month before the netting date: four (4) or more purchases make a regular buyer, and the milk-only price is added to every serving day counted; one to three purchases add once what the student spent on it in that month; no purchase adds nothing.

A date falls within the N months before the netting date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the netting date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it.

## Basis questions

**Is a student with exactly four purchases a regular buyer?** Yes; four or more purchases make a regular buyer.

**What is added for a student with three purchases?** Once, what the student spent on them in that month.

**And with no purchase in that month?** Nothing.

| Times milk bought on its own was rung up in the month before the netting date | What is added |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | the milk-only price (0.75) for every serving day counted |
| 1, 2 or 3 | what the student spent on it in that month, once |
| 0 | nothing |
